title: Red Hat Security Advisory: kernel security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: This Red Hat security advisory addresses multiple vulnerabilities and bugs in the Linux kernel packages for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8. The update includes fixes for several security issues such as use-after-free vulnerabilities, denial of service via unvalidated tasks in iSCSI, and privilege requirements for certain network operations. The advisory also includes various bug fixes and enhancements to improve kernel stability and security. Systems must be rebooted after applying the update for changes to take effect.
